name: Le Chamarel
site_text:
Welcome to Le Chamarel Restaurant
North London’s top Mauritian styled bistro, highlighting traditional authentic Mauritian dishes created by family recipes from over 40 years.
We hope to see you soon!
Our menu features a variety of your favourite Mauritian classics from a range of Biryani’s to Mine Frites, from our King Fish Vindaille to our Prawn and Octopus Rougaille’s… a “Le Chamarel” classic. We make everything in-house from our Dhall Puri’s and Roti’s – made fresh daily… to our amazing traditional sweets featuring sweets such as Napolitaine, Tarte Banane , Pujin Maize and many more.
We assure you the freshest, tastiest and delicious dishes to highlight the best of Mauritian cuisine.
We use top quality fresh ingredients, which we source from trusted suppliers from Billingsgate market to Spitafields market so we can serve you the finest of Mauritian dishes.
All of our spices are homemade and grinded from family recipes of over 40 years which gives our Curries, Rougailles, Vindailles and Biryani’s an exquisite flavour to our traditional Mauritian recipes.
Based in Turnpike Lane, we have brought traditional Mauritian cuisine at your doorstep offering you our multicultural menu, which consists of Creole, French, Indian and Sino-Mauritian dishes at the heart of North London.
Delicious meals, delivered by your head chef – Fazeel Damree
HEAD CHEF
Born to Mauritian parents in London, Fazeel Damree was brought up in Islington where he lives. Towards the end of his A-Levels, Le Chamarel opened on the 31st of July in 2009 where he went on to understand traditional Mauritian cuisine at its finest. Learning to cook from his mother from the age of 10, he did not truly understand the supremacy and value of Mauritian cuisine, yet he was good at it.
After studying at the ICCA Dubai of culinary arts he learnt a whole new concept of cooking, understanding a wider variety of ingredients and expanding his knowledge further on to continental cuisine.
After developing his skills in modern day professional cooking and having family recipes passed down to him, he has developed his menu in eager to bring popularity to a finer Mauritian cuisine. After starting his journey in Mauritian cuisine professionally from 2009, he believes that Mauritian food has a remarkable quality and is a culture that has brought on many aromatic herbs and spices to such delicious ingredients.
Fazeel’s aim is to take Mauritian cuisine into the next level, giving you the highest standard of Mauritian food to offer in North London’s, ‘Le Chamarel’.

About us & Photo Gallery
Le Chamarel and the food…
Let us introduce ourselves
Established on the 31st of July 2009, Le Chamarel is North London’s top Mauritian styled bistro, highlighting traditional authentic Mauritian dishes created by family recipes from over 40 years.
Our menu features a variety of your favourite Mauritian classics from a range of Biryani’s to Mine Frites, from our King Fish Vindaille to our Prawn and Octopus Rougaille’s… a “Le Chamarel” classic. We make everything in-house from our Dhall Puri’s and Roti’s – made fresh daily… to our amazing traditional sweets featuring sweets such as Napolitaine, Tarte Banane , Pujin Maize and many more.
We assure you the freshest, tastiest and delicious dishes to highlight the best of Mauritian cuisine.
What makes us different?
At Le Chamarel we have a team of devoted Mauritian chefs producing a range of quality authentic traditional Mauritian dishes.
We are able to offer you the widest variation of traditional Mauritian dishes, from our starters all the way to our desserts; every item is made on site meaning we give a lot of care and attention into our dishes to keep it at a high standard.

Always.

11 Bridge Street, Richmond, TW9 1TQ. Ten minutes on foot from Richmond station. The nearest car park is Friars Lane.

name: Goodman
site_text:
Welcome to goodman
A London institution, Goodman is a world-renowned steakhouse with a simple philosophy: ”Great steak, great wine, great people”
Meet Barry, our Group Senior Pastry Chef
INTERVIEW
“The cheesecake has to stay. Once we took the cheesecake off and put a lemon tart on instead… but not for long. People kept asking for it to come back.”
our beef
Only the perfect steak 
makes The Cut.
Each Goodman restaurant has its own ageing room, where we dry age already exceptional, expertly reared beef. Every day our chefs select the best steaks for The Cut, our daily specials board, and cut, trim and prepare them by hand.
our wine
Great wine has always been key to the Goodman experience, and we aim to make some of the finest wines in the world accessible to everyone.
our people
While what’s in your glass and on your plate are important, we still feel those are two-thirds of the whole picture. You also need people. And we think we’ve got some of the best.

Great meat doesn’t start on the plate. It starts on the farm.
Unlike many other restaurants, our relationship with our great steaks doesn’t begin in the kitchen. It starts in the fields of The British Isles and Nebraska.
It begins with the farmers who work with nature and use the best practices to raise the best cattle they possibly can. It starts with our suppliers, who work with these farmers who share our philosophy of doing things the right way.
Yes, it takes longer, but you can’t rush great beef.
And then, when it reaches us from the farms and ranches, from those carefully selected suppliers, we take even more time to turn this great beef into what we fully believe is the best beef available in the country.
Every Goodman restaurant has its own dry ageing room. The beef we’ve carefully sourced is aged in these temperature-controlled, dehumidified environments for a minimum of 30 days, a process that brings out the full concentration of flavour.
The Cut
Goodman’s version of field to plate can take years but, we think, it’s the right thing to do. And the results clearly speak for themselves.
Every day, our chefs check the ageing room, selecting the very best of our beef at its absolute peak. It’s then prepared, cut and trimmed by hand on that day: there’s a very good reason our daily specials board is known as “The Cut”.
All our beef is grilled over charcoal at around 400 degrees, using a mix of woods: oak and hickory for flavour and eucalyptus for a longer burn.
Our famous Josper ovens have been replaced with Mibrasas, which we think are now the best in the world.
They're beautifully insulated, which keeps the juices and flavours in and, just as importantly for our sustainability mission, they use around half the amount of charcoal.
Once the beef is cooked to the guest’s requirements, it's taken out of the Mibrasa, onto a tray, brushed with clarified butter, sprinkled with salt, and served straight away.
We're often asked why we don't rest the beef. Simply put, beef keeps cooking after you remove it from the grill.
our Head chefs
"We want you to have your steak as you ordered, and at its best."
Tim Delaney, Executive Chef

name: Scalini
site_text:
Scalini London
Your Favourite Local Italian
Established in 1988, welcome to Scalini, the beloved Italian neighbourhood restaurant in the heart of Chelsea, London, known for its tradition, quality and warm hospitality for over
thirty-five years.
With an extensive seasonal menu packed with regional favourites and Scalini classics, experience memorable, authentic Italian dining
Tuesday to Sunday.
Now with locations in Dubai, Doha, Cannes, Istanbul, Bahrain, Egypt and Lebanon. East Cairo opening 2026.

Step off Chelsea’s busy Walton Street into what Italians call qualcosa di speciale—something truly special. Established in 1988, Scalini brings the spirit of classic Italian dining to a Georgian townhouse in one of London’s most elegant neighbourhoods.
Scalini’s roots stretch back to 1959 with La Trattoria Terrazza in Soho. It was here that Scalini’s founders, Mario Paggetti and Valerio Calzolari, first met. Florentine restaurateur Mario Paggetti arrived in London during its culinary renaissance, opening Sale e Pepe, Sambuca and Signor Sassi in the 70's and 80's. In November 1988, Scalini opened its doors on Walton Street, where it still thrives today.
A major influence on Scalini’s success was founding Head Chef Luigi Ferraro, who led the kitchen for over 30 years. Shaped by Italy’s early trattoria tradition and a passion for simple, honest Tuscan cooking, Luigi's signature dishes use the finest local and Italian ingredients prepared with heart and without pretension. This straightforward, flavour-driven approach remains Scalini’s philosophy.
Today, Executive Chef Paulino Alves, along with Restaurant Manager Massimo and the team, continue to welcome generations of guests to the original Scalini in Walton Street, London. In recent years, Scalini has expanded to Dubai, Doha, Bahrain, Cannes, Istanbul and Egypt, bringing its timeless style and spirit of Italian dining to guests worldwide.

What began in 2002 as a dream to bring authentic French hospitality and cuisine to Chiswick grew into something far greater than a restaurant. Half Palestinian · Half German
Yvonne Osman — known to all as Om Waleed — is the passion, the precision and the panache behind Fait Maison. Her menu lives at the crossing of her paternal Palestinian and maternal German worlds, drawn from a childhood watched closely from her father's kitchen counter.
Her father's knowledge of Middle-Eastern cooking was remarkable. From a very young age she loved to watch and help him in the kitchen, learning to balance spice the way a musician balances chords. Her mother's cooking was extraordinary too — not only in taste, but in presentation. A feast for the eyes.
Decoration and ceremony shaped their home, and you can feel it everywhere at Fait Maison: in the chandeliers, the porcelain, the flowers at the door.
In Loving Memory
He was the heart of her kitchen long before there was a kitchen of her own — patient hands, generous spice, the quiet authority of a man who understood that to feed someone is to love them.
He passed away, and the loss was profound. He remains her deepest inspiration. Every plate that leaves Fait Maison carries something of him — the balance, the warmth, the insistence that nothing leaves the kitchen until it is right.
“Every dish I cook is a conversation with my father.”
A Life in Frames
Beyond the Kitchen
Om Waleed has worked tirelessly to bring about a new food revolution at Fait Maison — always experimenting, always plating with panache, always with her own distinctive take on traditional favourites.
Outside the kitchen, she is hugely active in encouraging, empowering and supporting other women in business. She carries a passion for fashion that she attributes to her elegant grandmother — utterly chic and immaculate in everything she did.

2026년 카지노사이트 선택 기준
안전한 온라인 카지노를 찾는 것은 쉽지 않습니다. 수백 개의 사이트가 있기 때문입니다. 명확한 기준이 필요합니다. 라이선스, 보안 수준, 사용자 평점이 중요합니다.
신뢰성 있는 라이선스 확인
카지노 라이선스는 사이트의 합법성을 증명합니다. Malta Gaming Authority(MGA)는 가장 엄격한 규제를 적용합니다. 라이선스 유무를 확인하는 것이 중요합니다.
- MGA – 유럽 기반, 가장 높은 신뢰도
- UK Gambling Commission – 영국 시장 규제
- Curaçao eGaming – 빠른 발급, 폭넓은 적용
보안 시스템 점검
SSL 암호화 기술은 개인정보 보호에 필수적입니다. 256비트 SSL 암호화와 PCI DSS 준수 여부를 확인해야 합니다. 보안이 취약한 사이트는 해킹 위험에 노출됩니다.

| SSL 암호화 | 256비트 이상 | 매우 높음 | 
| PCI DSS 인증 | Level 1 준수 | 높음 | 
| 2단계 인증(2FA) | 필수 지원 | 보통 | 
사용자 후기 분석
사용자 평가는 솔직한 정보입니다. Trustpilot과 AskGamblers에서 4.0 이상 평점을 가진 사이트를 선택하세요. 먹튀 커뮤니티의 리뷰도 참고하세요.
안전한 카지노사이트는 라이선스, 보안, 실사용자 리뷰 세 가지를 모두 충족합니다.
슬롯사이트 인기 조사 방법
슬롯사이트의 인기 수준을 정확히 파악하려면 체계적인 분석이 필요합니다. 단순히 광고나 입소문만 믿지 마세요. 중요한 지표들인 슬롯 RTP, 변동성 분석, 게임 공정성을 기준으로 분석해야 합니다.
사용자의 요구 조사
한국 플레이어들은 높은 당첨 가능성과 재미를 동시에 원합니다. 최근 조사에 따르면, Book of Dead, Starburst, Gates of Olympus 같은 게임이 인기를 끌고 있습니다. 프로그레시브 잭팟 기능이 있는 게임에 대한 관심도 증가하고 있습니다.
슬롯 게임 종류 분석
슬롯 게임은 제공업체에 따라 다양한 특성을 가집니다. 변동성 분석을 통해 각 게임의 리스크와 보상 구조를 이해할 수 있습니다.

랜덤 넘버 생성기 이해
게임의 공정성을 보장하는 핵심 기술은 랜덤 넘버 생성기(RNG)입니다. 이 시스템은 매 스핀의 결과를 완전히 무작위로 생성합니다. eCOGRA와 iTech Labs의 RNG 인증을 받은 사이트는 신뢰할 수 있는 환경을 제공합니다.
RNG 인증은 슬롯 결과가 조작되지 않았음을 독립 기관이 검증한 것을 의미합니다.
인증 여부를 확인하는 습관은 안전한 슬롯사이트를 선택하는 첫 단계입니다. 이 기준들을 바탕으로 다음 섹션에서 소개할 카지노사이트 평점을 더 정확히 이해할 수 있습니다.

객관적 평가 지표는 여러 가지 항목으로 나뉘어집니다. 각 항목은 다른 가중치를 가집니다.
- 게임 다양성 — 25%
- 보너스 조건 — 20%
- 출금 속도 — 20%

카지노 평점 시스템은 매월 업데이트를 합니다. 새로운 프로모션, 출금 정책 변경, 보안 패치가 즉시 반영됩니다.
